title: A decision in the general thread answers an inline request

pr.title: Give fetchUser a request timeout
pr.description: fetchUser now stops a request after 5 seconds. The callers keep their retry loop.

messages.author: Bob Lee
messages.text: Callers retry. The client must not retry, or we retry 9 times.

messages.author: Eval User
messages.text: Agreed. No retry in the client.
